'''The Terror Kreetle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Syndicate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Terror Kreetle often raided the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in his [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]].<ref name="SWG:CS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempHutt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of the Terror Kreetle]]
The Terror Kreetle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Terror Kreetle was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. The Terror Kreetle was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Hutt pirate starfighters in the Corellian system.<ref name="SWG:CS" />
